name: 2022-1c-parcial1-cryptic
title: ISW1-F1 Formula One Simulator (cryptic names)
description: A Formula 1 race simulator (GrandPrix, Track made of Sectors, FormulaOneCar with a Turbo that boosts speed 20%/10%/5% and then is exhausted, usable only to overtake a car less than a second ahead in a turbo-enabled sector). The student must replace ifs with polymorphism (turbo states, sectors with/without turbo), rewrite index-based loops in Track and GrandPrix with collection protocol, remove duplication in the tests and improve the design while keeping all tests green. Cryptic twin: every class, selector, variable, symbol and string the exercise's author named is replaced by a meaningless one (level 2), comments removed; renames.json has the table.

design.notes: The turbo is a small state machine (deactivated, activated after 1/2/3 uses, exhausted) encoded as a boolean plus a counter and checked with ifs across FormulaOneCar and Sector; Track and GrandPrix walk sectors and cars with whileTrue: index loops that map directly onto detect:/inject:/anySatisfy:, and tests 20-25 repeat the same fixture setup.
